title: Job Application for Software Engineer II, Developer Portal (New Grad / Early Career) at ID.me
content:
This is a backend-leaning full-stack role. You'll work on the services, APIs, and data models behind the portal (application registration, authorization, and the developer-facing APIs our customers integrate against), and you'll ship the user-facing surfaces those services power in our Next.js and React frontend. You'll start with well-scoped features alongside senior engineers and grow quickly into owning features end-to-end, from API contract to production. [...] Our backend services are primarily Java (Spring Boot) alongside legacy Ruby services. The frontend is a micro-frontend platform built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. You don't need to know all of these on day one. If your fundamentals are strong, we're confident you'll pick up whatever the problem requires.

## What You'll Do

### Build and Ship Developer Features [...] Design, implement, test, and deploy Developer Portal capabilities across the stack: backend APIs, database changes, and the frontend experiences customers use. Start with well-defined features and bugs, then take on progressively larger and more ambiguous work as you grow.

# Software Engineer (New Grad December 2026)

## SOFTWARE ENGINEER (NEW GRAD DECEMBER 2026)

Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation.
